Virgam virtutis tuæ emittet Dominus ex Sion:
The Lord will send forth the scepter of your virtue from Zion.
Rule in the midst of your enemies.
Tecum principium in die virtutis tuæ in splendoribus sanctorum:
It is with you from the beginning, in the day of your virtue, in the splendor of the saints.
Tu es sacerdos in æternum secundum ordinem Melchisedech.
“You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
The Lord is at your right hand.
confregit in die iræ suæ reges.
He has broken kings in the day of his wrath.
He will judge between the nations;
He will shatter heads in the land of the many.
He will drink from the torrent on the way.
Because of this, he will exalt the head.
